text.title: 谈钱不伤感情
text.body: 谈钱不伤感情，不谈钱的最后都伤了感情。给钱，给建议，|不给钱没意见，有付出意识的忙，帮，没有付出意识的忙，不帮，|不是说吝啬，而是没有付出意识的忙，帮了，别人不会珍惜，|不给钱的建议，给了，别人就不会当回事。
text.en: Talking about money does not hurt a relationship; those who never talk about it are the ones who end up hurting it. Give money, give advice; if no money is given, have no complaints. A favor given with a sense of payment - help; a favor without it - do not help. This is not stinginess: help without that sense will not be cherished, and advice given for free will not be taken seriously.
text.credit: 原作 维米尔《持天平的女人》约1664年 · 荷兰布面油画 · 灰蓝墙暖光
